connection_condition: County membership is carried by the leading two digits of the CDS code and by the parallel County and County Name columns, since no separate county table exists.
description: A county is composed of the districts and county offices within it; a district belongs to exactly one county.

connection_condition: A school's district is the agency record whose CDS code shares its first seven characters; the district code is embedded in every school's CDS code.
description: A district is composed of the schools it operates; a school's record is meaningless without the district that administers it.

connection_condition: Charter-flagged records are drawn from the same population as schools and are identified by a flag rather than a separate table.
description: A charter school is a kind of school; the set of charter-flagged records is a subset of all school records.

connection_condition: schools.CDSCode and satscores.cds denote the same school or agency; satscores stores the value with the leading zero of the county code stripped, so the two forms coincide only after normalisation.
description: The same identifier is held in two representations; the SAT file's shorter form is an alternative encoding of the CDS code rather than a different identifier.

connection_condition: Both counts are reported side by side for the same school and enrollment basis, and the free-meal count is never the larger of the two.
description: Free-meal eligibility is a component part of FRPM eligibility, which additionally includes reduced-price-meal eligibility.

connection_condition: The stored rate reproduces exactly from the FRPM count divided by the enrollment count for every non-null row.
description: The FRPM eligibility rate is computed as the FRPM count divided by the enrollment count on the same basis.

connection_condition: The stored rate reproduces from the free-meal count divided by the enrollment count for every non-null row.
description: The free-meal eligibility rate is computed as the free-meal count divided by the enrollment count on the same basis.

connection_condition: The count of high scorers and the total test takers are reported in the same record, so the share is fully determined by that row.
description: The share of test takers scoring 1500 or above is computed as that count divided by the number of test takers.

connection_condition: Test takers and grade-12 enrollment are reported in the same record, so the rate is determined by that row wherever grade-12 enrollment is positive.
description: The SAT participation rate is computed as the number of test takers divided by grade-12 enrollment.

connection_condition: SAT records reach their school through the CDS code, and school-level records are distinguished from district-level ones by the record level flag.
description: A school's SAT results describe its own grade-12 test takers; the linkage is through the shared identifier rather than a structural dependency.

connection_condition: Both columns are recorded for the same schools in the same file and leave the same 45 district-level rows blank.
description: School Type and Educational Option Type classify the same schools along different axes; their vocabularies overlap in meaning but are not interchangeable.

connection_condition: The two counts are reported side by side for the same school and coincide for some schools while differing for others.
description: The two enrollment columns describe overlapping student populations and produce different eligibility denominators for the same school.

connection_condition: Both are enrollment counts for the same schools but are recorded in different tables and joined through the CDS code.
description: Grade-12 enrollment is a grade-specific subset of a school's overall enrollment and is measured in the SAT file rather than the FRPM file.
